mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.post_id AS postId, r.user_id AS userId, r.parent_id AS parentId, r.floor, r.content, r.status, r.create_time AS createTime, u.username AS authorName, u.avatar AS authorAvatar FROM reply r LEFT JOIN `user` u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.post_id = #{postId} AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.floor ASC
SELECT MAX(floor) FROM reply WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
